_doc: sta3: ROM step-mode milestones (probe frame domain, Scene ON; gBattlescriptCurrInstr per frame, tools/audio/sta3RomWindow.py) of the second Status_* play's pre-move print. anchorPrint = the preceding print's instruction row, moveEnd = BattleScript_MoveEnd's first row, print = BattleScript_MoveUsedIsConfused / IsAsleep's printstring row, waitDone = its waitmessage completion row, launch = the status(2)animation execution row (gAnimScriptActive 1).
